analysis.summary: Manav Infra Projects Limited reported revenue from operations of Rs. 4,155.77 lakhs and a net profit of Rs. 402.55 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Management noted the company's identification of roads and highways, real estate, and heavy civil construction works as potential growth segments to diversify operations and reduce dependence on any single sector. The Board did not recommend any dividend for the financial year due to current financial position, economic scenario, and future fund requirements.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has identified roads and highways, real estate, and other heavy civil construction works as potential growth segments.
demand_outlook.quote: MIP has identified roads & highways, real estate and other heavy civil construction works as a potential growth segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the outlook is bright and the company is poised for sustained growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company is poised for sustained growth and the outlook is bright.

capital_allocation.claim: The company fully repaid all unsecured loans previously obtained from the directors.
capital_allocation.quote: Further, the Company has fully repaid all unsecured loans previously obtained from the Directors.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not avail any new unsecured loans from the directors during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company did not avail any new unsecured loans from the Directors of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued 6,324,000 equity shares on a rights basis at a price of Rs. 11 per share aggregating up to Rs. 695.64 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company has issued 63,24,000 Equity Shares of face value Rs. 10/- each at price of Rs. 11/- each on a rights basis including premium of Rs. 1/- to existing equity shareholders of the Company (“Rights Issue”) aggregating upto Rs. 695.64 Lakhs opened for subscription on 12th March, 2025 and the subscription was closed on 24th March, 2025.
